approved_scope.title: Report persistence failures to an overridable Application method
approved_scope.description: Report persistence failures to an overridable Application method
acceptance_criteria: PersistenceFailureTests passes: an Application subclass that overrides didFailToPersist hears a FileState read failure for a file that cannot be decoded, a FileState write failure, a rejected StoredState value and a SyncState value that cannot be encoded, each with the store, operation, key and error; it hears nothing for a successful round trip or for a FileState that was never written; an application without the override behaves as before; every test class passes on macOS under the strict build and in a release build, the Linux suite passes on Swift 6.1 and the WASI build passes

answers.constraints: Additive only: no existing declaration, log line or fallback value may change. SyncState only inside canImport(Security). Swift 6 with explicit access control and no force-unwrap. Must build on Linux, Windows and WASI.
